items.title: How many users a bad deploy reaches before rollback finishes
items.description: Grounded in L1's Scenario: a bad deploy fails 1 in 8 requests (12.5% error rate) at 1,200 requests per minute. This shows how many failed requests accumulate the longer rollback takes — the default (40 minutes) reproduces the Scenario's manual rebuild-rollback; drag it down to 2 minutes to see the ready-artifact team's outcome.

params.name: errorRatePercent
params.label: Error rate during the bad deploy

items.compute: const failedRequests = Math.round(params.requestsPerMinute * params.minutesToRollback * (params.errorRatePercent / 100)); return { failedRequests };
